title: Icons / transport mark and navigation
slide_intent: Test symbols at both prominent and compact sizes so recognition survives changes of context.
strategic_value: A consistent DB line language can connect a large transport symbol with small navigation controls.
demonstration: A large frontal transit icon sits beside a rounded four-item navigation bar with icon labels.
practical_value: Compare the visual weight of a standalone transport symbol and icons paired with text.

content_islands.name: Transport specimen
content_islands.spec: Place the enlarged frontal vehicle symbol on a light field.

content_islands.name: Navigation bar
content_islands.spec: Arrange Buchen, Umgebung, Reisen and Profil controls horizontally at right.

reference_purposes.Application: The right specimen shows icons as labeled navigation controls.
reference_purposes.Expression: The large vehicle and compact controls use the same dark outline language.
